dialogues.jp: 昨日は、さっそく一日中寝て過ごした。
dialogues.en: I literally slept through the entire of yesterday.
dialogues.text: I literally slept through the entire of yesterday.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに夕食時になっても、音夢が一言も口を
聞いてくれなかった。
dialogues.en: Until evening, I didn't hear even a peep from Nemu.
dialogues.text: Until evening, I didn't hear even a peep from Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
だから、せめて今日は学校へ行かずとも人並み
の一日を送ろうと、決心した。
dialogues.en: So, I was determined to wake up earlier at least, in return.
dialogues.text: So, I was determined to wake up earlier at least, in return.

dialogues.jp:
１０時になってベッドからはい出る。その時間
が人並みなのかと問われたら、俺は『エヘヘ』
と笑って済ませることにする。
dialogues.en:
Today, I got out of bed at 10 AM. I smiled to myself at the
thought of that soon becoming the norm.
dialogues.text:
Today, I got out of bed at 10 AM. I smiled to myself at the
thought of that soon becoming the norm.

dialogues.jp:
先日まで、普通に学校へ通っていたのが、ウソ
みたいだ。
dialogues.en:
The days of going to school normally are alredays tarting to
seem like a distant dream.
dialogues.text:
The days of going to school normally are alredays tarting to
seem like a distant dream.

dialogues.jp:
日曜日でも、春休みでもない、卒業生だけの特
権だ。
dialogues.en:
It's not Sunday or spring break yet; it's just the privilege
given to the students graduating this year.
dialogues.text:
It's not Sunday or spring break yet; it's just the privilege
given to the students graduating this year.

dialogues.jp:
とはいえ、まだ卒業式が残っているから、そん
なおおげさなものではないのだけれど。
dialogues.en:
In other words, the poor students that aren't third years
don't get the break I do.
dialogues.text:
In other words, the poor students that aren't third years
don't get the break I do.

dialogues.jp: そういえば、月城はどうしてるだろう。
dialogues.en: Speaking of which, I wonder how Tsukishiro's doing.
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I wonder how Tsukishiro's doing.

dialogues.jp:
今日もまた体育館裏で育てているあの草の世話
をしているのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
She's probably still trying to make that plant behind the
gym grow.
dialogues.text:
She's probably still trying to make that plant behind the
gym grow.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、主婦向けのテレビ番組を見ながら、ソ
ファーの上でパンをかじる。
dialogues.en:
I fell onto the sofa, watching a TV program made for
housewives.
dialogues.text:
I fell onto the sofa, watching a TV program made for
housewives.

dialogues.jp:
主婦向けの番組って、見てれば見てるほど、俺
がダメ人間になっていくような気がする。
dialogues.en:
Anyone looking at me now would probably think I was someone
lazy, useless idiot.
dialogues.text:
Anyone looking at me now would probably think I was someone
lazy, useless idiot.

dialogues.jp: 「暇だし、月城の様子でも見に行ってみるか」
dialogues.en:
"Since I have nothing to do, I guess I'd go check up on
Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text:
"Since I have nothing to do, I guess I'd go check up on
Tsukishiro."

dialogues.jp:
ちょうど今から出て行けば、昼休憩辺りになり
そうな気がする。
dialogues.en:
If I leave about now, I should make it around the lunch
break period.
dialogues.text:
If I leave about now, I should make it around the lunch
break period.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、テレビを消し、大きく伸びをする。
dialogues.en: I switched off the TV, and did a big stretch.
dialogues.text: I switched off the TV, and did a big stretch.

dialogues.jp:
俺が休みでも、学校はやっている。音夢も今朝
から風紀委員の仕事だと言って、でかけていっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Even during the so-called holidays, I end up going to
school. Nemu also went earlier this morning, with
disciplinary committee work.
dialogues.text:
Even during the so-called holidays, I end up going to
school. Nemu also went earlier this morning, with
disciplinary committee work.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに私服で出かけていったら、変に目立っ
ちゃったりするだろうな。この前みたいに。
dialogues.en:
I knew that if I wore casual clothes, I'd be stared at
weirdly by others from past experiences.
dialogues.text:
I knew that if I wore casual clothes, I'd be stared at
weirdly by others from past experiences.

dialogues.jp: だから、今日はちゃんと制服を着てきたぞ。
dialogues.en: So this time, I changed into my uniform first.
dialogues.text: So this time, I changed into my uniform first.

dialogues.jp:
制服を着ているというのに、なぜかこそこそと
辺りの様子を窺いながら、校門をくぐる。
dialogues.en:
Yet, even though I was in full uniform, I was still looking
around nervously as I approached the school gates.
dialogues.text:
Yet, even though I was in full uniform, I was still looking
around nervously as I approached the school gates.

dialogues.jp: 「誰にも見つかりませんように……」
dialogues.en: "No one seems to have spotted me..."
dialogues.text: "No one seems to have spotted me..."

dialogues.jp:
別に誰に見つかってもやましい訳ではないのに、
俺は人目を避け、体育館裏の方に足を向ける。
dialogues.en:
Although I had no reason to feel guilty, I still didn't
really want to be seen as I made my way to the rear of the
gym.
dialogues.text:
Although I had no reason to feel guilty, I still didn't
really want to be seen as I made my way to the rear of the
gym.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに下級生は普通に学校に来ている分、学
校はいつものように｛にぎ／賑｝やかだった。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to all the lowerclassmen, the school was still
bustling as usual.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to all the lowerclassmen, the school was still
bustling as usual.

dialogues.jp: チャイムがなり、昼休憩になる。
dialogues.en:
The chime then sounded, signalling the start of lunch
period.
dialogues.text:
The chime then sounded, signalling the start of lunch
period.

dialogues.jp:
ここで待っていれば、月城もそのうちに来るだ
ろう。
dialogues.en:
If I wait here, surely Tsukishiro will show up sooner or
later.
dialogues.text:
If I wait here, surely Tsukishiro will show up sooner or
later.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、壁に立てかけてあるブロックに腰をかけ、
月城が来るのを待つ。
dialogues.en:
I sat down, leaning against the wall, waiting for
Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
I sat down, leaning against the wall, waiting for
Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp: 「水でも汲んどいてやろうかな」
dialogues.en: "It looks like it needs some water."
dialogues.text: "It looks like it needs some water."

dialogues.jp:
と思ったけれど、余計なことをしてこぼしてし
まったりしたら大変だ。
dialogues.en: Although too much probably won't be good for it either.
dialogues.text: Although too much probably won't be good for it either.

dialogues.jp:
しばらくすると、じょうろを持った月城が、やっ
てきた。
dialogues.en: Shortly, Tsukishiro arrived, holding a sprinkling can,
dialogues.text: Shortly, Tsukishiro arrived, holding a sprinkling can,

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「やあ、月城。ちょっと気になったから、見に
　きたぞ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tsukishiro. Just came to see how it was doing."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tsukishiro. Just came to see how it was doing."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、なんだか気まずそうな表情で、首を傾
げると特に何も言わずに、草の前にしゃがんだ。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, with an unreadable expression on her face,
squatted down next to the plant.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, with an unreadable expression on her face,
squatted down next to the plant.

dialogues.jp: そして、じょうろの水をゆっくりとかけていく。
dialogues.en: And calmly poured water onto it.
dialogues.text: And calmly poured water onto it.

dialogues.jp: 「調子はどうだ？　花は咲きそうか？」
dialogues.en: "How's it? Any flower blossoming?"
dialogues.text: "How's it? Any flower blossoming?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "......Not yet."
dialogues.text: "......Not yet."

dialogues.jp: 月城は、ふるふると首を横に振った。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro shook her head, her ponytails fluttering.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro shook her head, her ponytails fluttering.

dialogues.jp:
そして、ふぅとため息をつき、手袋を外し人形
を触る。
dialogues.en:
And with a sudden sign, removed her gloves and stroked her
doll.
dialogues.text:
And with a sudden sign, removed her gloves and stroked her
doll.

dialogues.jp: それまで無口だった人形が口を開く。
dialogues.en: The then-silent doll, started to open it's mouth.
dialogues.text: The then-silent doll, started to open it's mouth.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「この花は、育てるのが難しいんだ」
dialogues.en: "Growing this flower is very difficult."
dialogues.text: "Growing this flower is very difficult."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そうなのか」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「でも、どうしても花を咲かせたいんだ」
dialogues.en: "But somehow, we'd make a flower grow out of this."
dialogues.text: "But somehow, we'd make a flower grow out of this."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「人に、教えちゃダメなんだっけ？」
dialogues.en: "We can't tell anyone about this?"
dialogues.text: "We can't tell anyone about this?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「うん、朝倉先輩でも、教えられない」
dialogues.en: "Yes. No one else should know, except Asakura-senpai."
dialogues.text: "Yes. No one else should know, except Asakura-senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「にしても、大変だな、毎日」
dialogues.en: "But it must be hard, doing this every day."
dialogues.text: "But it must be hard, doing this every day."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉先輩だって、いつもここに来ているじゃ
　ないか」
dialogues.en: "But you also always comes here anyway, right?"
dialogues.text: "But you also always comes here anyway, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「俺は、見てるだけだからな」
dialogues.en: "I always just come to have a look."
dialogues.text: "I always just come to have a look."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「こんな薄暗いところに来るなんて、物好きだ
　ね……」
dialogues.en:
"Coming to this gloomy place, just out of curiosity's sake,
eh..."
dialogues.text:
"Coming to this gloomy place, just out of curiosity's sake,
eh..."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「お前に言われたかないよ……って、あ、月城
　に言ったんじゃないぞ。この人形に言ったん
　だ。ホントだぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"You're one to talk... oh, wait, it's not Tsukishiro
talking, just this doll. You believe me, right, Tsukishiro?"
dialogues.text:
"You're one to talk... oh, wait, it's not Tsukishiro
talking, just this doll. You believe me, right, Tsukishiro?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「アリスの気持ちはボクの気持ち。ボクに言っ
　たってことはアリスに言ったってのと一緒だ
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"Alice's feelings are my feelings. The things I say are the
things Alice would say too."
dialogues.text:
"Alice's feelings are my feelings. The things I say are the
things Alice would say too."

dialogues.jp: チッと舌を鳴らす。口の減らない人形だ。
dialogues.en: This doll just doesn't stop talking.
dialogues.text: This doll just doesn't stop talking.

dialogues.jp:
「俺は単純に月城とその草が気になるから来て
　るだけだ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm simply worried about Tsukishiro and that plant, so I
come here all the time."
dialogues.text:
"I'm simply worried about Tsukishiro and that plant, so I
come here all the time."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「アリスに近寄ってどうする気なんだ」
dialogues.en: "And you want to get closer to Alice, right?"
dialogues.text: "And you want to get closer to Alice, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「どうする気もこうする気も……俺は、月城と
　ともだ……」
dialogues.en:
"What do you mean by that... I just want to, like
ATsukishiro..."
dialogues.text:
"What do you mean by that... I just want to, like
ATsukishiro..."

dialogues.jp:
と言いかけたところを、何者かが乱入して｛さえぎ／遮｝っ
てくる。
dialogues.en: Before I could finish, I was rudely interrupted.
dialogues.text: Before I could finish, I was rudely interrupted.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なかなか、面白そうなことをしてるじゃない
　か、同志よ……」
dialogues.en:
"You appear to have stumbled onto something very
interesting, comrade..."
dialogues.text:
"You appear to have stumbled onto something very
interesting, comrade..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「きッ、貴様は杉並ッ！」
dialogues.en: "Y, you're Suginami!"
dialogues.text: "Y, you're Suginami!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そう、俺は杉並。常に世界を見つめる男」
dialogues.en:
"That's right, my name is Suginami. The man watched by the
world."
dialogues.text:
"That's right, my name is Suginami. The man watched by the
world."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……くだらん前口上はいい。いつからそこに
　いたんだ」
dialogues.en:
"...Quit the stupid introductions. How long have you been
here?"
dialogues.text:
"...Quit the stupid introductions. How long have you been
here?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前が、ここに来る前から｛つ／尾行｝けてきていた」
dialogues.en: "I've shadowed you since you left your home."
dialogues.text: "I've shadowed you since you left your home."

dialogues.jp: 杉並がアゴに手を添え、不敵な笑みを浮かべる。
dialogues.en:
Suginami hangs hand went to his chin, with a fearless grin
on his face.
dialogues.text:
Suginami hangs hand went to his chin, with a fearless grin
on his face.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……杉並、先輩？」
dialogues.en: "...Suginami, senpai?"
dialogues.text: "...Suginami, senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほう、俺を知っているのか」
dialogues.en: "Ho, even you have heard of me."
dialogues.text: "Ho, even you have heard of me."

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro nodded.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro nodded.

dialogues.jp: 「俺とお前は、下級生の悪い見本らしい」
dialogues.en:
"We've been put up to the lowerclassmen as examples not to
follow."
dialogues.text:
"We've been put up to the lowerclassmen as examples not to
follow."

dialogues.jp: いつだったか、そんなことを聞いたことがある。
dialogues.en: I hear that all the time while passing by.
dialogues.text: I hear that all the time while passing by.

dialogues.jp:
暦先生が『ああいう連中にだけはなっちゃダメ
だ』と下級生の授業で吹いているらしい。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei's always telling the lowerclassmen "Don't be
like those people".
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei's always telling the lowerclassmen "Don't be
like those people".

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「本当か？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ふ……俺も有名になったものだな」
dialogues.en: "Ha... fame has finally reached me."
dialogues.text: "Ha... fame has finally reached me."

dialogues.jp: 杉並が、爽やかっぽく髪の毛をかき揚げる。
dialogues.en: Suginami brought his hand through his hair.
dialogues.text: Suginami brought his hand through his hair.

dialogues.jp: そして、俺と月城を交互に見て、
dialogues.en: Then turned to look at me and Alice, alternately.
dialogues.text: Then turned to look at me and Alice, alternately.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ところで、朝倉よ。お前……えーと、君はな
　んという名前だ？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way, Asakura. You've... erm, what would your name
be?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way, Asakura. You've... erm, what would your name
be?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……月城、アリス」
dialogues.en: "...Tsukishiro, Alice."
dialogues.text: "...Tsukishiro, Alice."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「月城嬢……か。その容姿と名前からすると、
　純粋な日本人ではないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro-jou, then. With that appearance and name, you
must not be a pure Japanese, correct?
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro-jou, then. With that appearance and name, you
must not be a pure Japanese, correct?

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: The usual nod.
dialogues.text: The usual nod.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「それで、だ。朝倉に月城嬢。お前達二人は先
　ほどなにやら面白げなことをしていたようだ
　が……」
dialogues.en:
"And also, Asakura and Tsukishiro-jou. The two of you were
talking about something rather interesting earlier...
dialogues.text:
"And also, Asakura and Tsukishiro-jou. The two of you were
talking about something rather interesting earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「面白そうなことだと？」
dialogues.en: "Something interesting?"
dialogues.text: "Something interesting?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「腹話術で会話をしていただろう？」
dialogues.en: "A conversation about ventriloquism, was it not?"
dialogues.text: "A conversation about ventriloquism, was it not?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「え、いや……その……」
dialogues.en: "Eh... no... that's..."
dialogues.text: "Eh... no... that's..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、月城嬢の持っている人形だ」
dialogues.en: "C'mon, look at the doll Tsukishiro-jou's carrying."
dialogues.text: "C'mon, look at the doll Tsukishiro-jou's carrying."

dialogues.jp:
ちらりと月城の方を見ると、彼女は、眉をひそ
め俯いている。
dialogues.en:
Glancing at Tsukishiro, her eyebrows were raised in
surprise.
dialogues.text:
Glancing at Tsukishiro, her eyebrows were raised in
surprise.

dialogues.jp: 腕の中では人形がだらりと首を垂らしている。
dialogues.en: The doll's head was hanging lifelessly.
dialogues.text: The doll's head was hanging lifelessly.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「──ボクのことだね、杉並先輩」
dialogues.en: "--You mean about me, Suginami-senapi?"
dialogues.text: "--You mean about me, Suginami-senapi?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、慌てて手袋をはめようとするが、その
拍子に地面に落としてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, in a rush to put her gloves back on,
accidentally dropped them to the floor.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, in a rush to put her gloves back on,
accidentally dropped them to the floor.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ボクはピロス。人形だけど、こうしてアリス
　の気持ちを伝えることができるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm Piros. I may be just a doll, but I can communicate
Alice's feelings to anyone."
dialogues.text:
"I'm Piros. I may be just a doll, but I can communicate
Alice's feelings to anyone."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……ほう、たいしたものだ」
dialogues.en: "...Hmm, a very important object, indeed."
dialogues.text: "...Hmm, a very important object, indeed."

dialogues.jp: 珍しく杉並が感嘆の声をあげる。
dialogues.en: Suginami actually had admiration in his voice, a rare event.
dialogues.text: Suginami actually had admiration in his voice, a rare event.

dialogues.jp:
月城は、手袋を拾いながら、ふぅとため息をつ
いている。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro eventually found her gloves, and sighed with
relief.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro eventually found her gloves, and sighed with
relief.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「たいしたものじゃないか、ピロスキーとやら」
dialogues.en: "You're a special little thing aren't you, Pirosuki."
dialogues.text: "You're a special little thing aren't you, Pirosuki."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ピロスキーじゃない。ピロスだ」
dialogues.en: "I'm not Pirosuki, I'm Piros!"
dialogues.text: "I'm not Pirosuki, I'm Piros!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ピロ助？　いや、ピロスキーだな」
dialogues.en: "Pirosuke? No, Pirosuki fits better."
dialogues.text: "Pirosuke? No, Pirosuki fits better."

dialogues.jp: くくくと自分のネーミングセンスに笑う杉並。
dialogues.en: He was snickering at his own, deranged, naming sense.
dialogues.text: He was snickering at his own, deranged, naming sense.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「アリスは喋るのが苦手だから、こうしてボク
　が代わりに喋ってるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Alice isn't good at talking, so I do the talking for her
instead."
dialogues.text:
"Alice isn't good at talking, so I do the talking for her
instead."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なかなか変わった芸だな」
dialogues.en: "A very peculiar act."
dialogues.text: "A very peculiar act."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「芸じゃない！」
dialogues.en: "I'm not an act!"
dialogues.text: "I'm not an act!"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「わかったら、さっさとどこかへ行けよ」
dialogues.en: "If you've had enough, go somewhere else already."
dialogues.text: "If you've had enough, go somewhere else already."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おっと、そんなに邪険にすることはないだろ
　う、朝倉よ？」
dialogues.en:
"My, you certainly don't mean such harsh, cruel words like
that, do you, Asakura?"
dialogues.text:
"My, you certainly don't mean such harsh, cruel words like
that, do you, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「お前が絡むとなんでもややこしいことになる
　んだよ」
dialogues.en: "The less we get involved with you, the better."
dialogues.text: "The less we get involved with you, the better."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「嫌われたものだな……。まあいい、朝倉よ、
　そして月城嬢、また会おう」
dialogues.en:
"How unpleasant... in any case, Asakura and Tsukishiro-jou,
until we meet again!"
dialogues.text:
"How unpleasant... in any case, Asakura and Tsukishiro-jou,
until we meet again!"

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、まるでマントでも翻すかのように、大
きく腕を振り上げ、茂みの中に消えていった。
dialogues.en:
Suginami, as if manipulating a cape, made a exaggerated wave
with his entire arm, and disappeared into a thicket.
dialogues.text:
Suginami, as if manipulating a cape, made a exaggerated wave
with his entire arm, and disappeared into a thicket.

dialogues.jp: 相変わらず、よくわからんヤツだな。
dialogues.en: As always, a completely incomprehensible idiot.
dialogues.text: As always, a completely incomprehensible idiot.

dialogues.jp: 俺と月城の足下を軽く風が吹き抜ける。
dialogues.en: A light wind started blowing past our feet.
dialogues.text: A light wind started blowing past our feet.

dialogues.jp: 「悪いな、変なヤツが出てきて……」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, letting a fool like that tail me..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, letting a fool like that tail me..."

dialogues.jp: 月城がふるふると首を横に振る。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro shook her head from side to side.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro shook her head from side to side.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「別に、大丈夫だよ。杉並先輩なら」
dialogues.en: "It'd be fine. It's Suginami-senpai, after all."
dialogues.text: "It'd be fine. It's Suginami-senpai, after all."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そうなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is that so?"
dialogues.text: "Is that so?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「ボクの知ってる杉並先輩は、ボクみたいな人
　形がお話ししても、変に思わないからね」
dialogues.en:
"If what I heard about him is true, he wouldn't consider
talking to a doll like me as strange at all."
dialogues.text:
"If what I heard about him is true, he wouldn't consider
talking to a doll like me as strange at all."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ま、確かにそうかもしれんな」
dialogues.en: "I guess that may be right."
dialogues.text: "I guess that may be right."

dialogues.jp:
少なくとも、変に驚いたり怖がったりは、絶対
にしないヤツだ。
dialogues.en:
At least, he won't intentionally try to scare others with
stories like that.
dialogues.text:
At least, he won't intentionally try to scare others with
stories like that.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「でも……、ここはあまり知られたくなかった
　かな。ボクのことも……」
dialogues.en:
"But... it's not good that he knows about this place. And
myself as well..."
dialogues.text:
"But... it's not good that he knows about this place. And
myself as well..."

dialogues.jp:
未だに、月城が喋っているのか、本当に人形が
喋っているのかわからない。
dialogues.en:
I don't know whether that was Tsukishiro or the doll
talking.
dialogues.text:
I don't know whether that was Tsukishiro or the doll
talking.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、どっちにしても、人形の発言が月城の
気持ちであることは間違いなさそうだ。
dialogues.en:
But, whichever it was, it was obvious that Tsukishiro's
feelings concurred with that statement.
dialogues.text:
But, whichever it was, it was obvious that Tsukishiro's
feelings concurred with that statement.

dialogues.jp: 「あいつには、俺からよく言い聞かせておくよ」
dialogues.en: "I'd make sure to talk to him about it."
dialogues.text: "I'd make sure to talk to him about it."

dialogues.jp:
とはいっても、あいつなりに興味を持ったみた
いだから、なかなか難しいかも知れないが。
dialogues.en:
Given the interest he has in it though, it'd be difficult to
get him to forget about it completely...
dialogues.text:
Given the interest he has in it though, it'd be difficult to
get him to forget about it completely...

dialogues.jp:
だけど、他言はしないようにというくらいはちゃ
んと言っておかないとな。
dialogues.en:
But at the very least, I should be able to get him to shut
up about it to others.
dialogues.text:
But at the very least, I should be able to get him to shut
up about it to others.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、まあ、あいつもよく知れば、なかなか
　面白いヤツだよ」
dialogues.en:
"And, besides, once you get to know him, he's quite an
interesting guy."
dialogues.text:
"And, besides, once you get to know him, he's quite an
interesting guy."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「……そうなの？」
dialogues.en: "...Really?"
dialogues.text: "...Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「悪いヤツじゃあない。まだ人のココロは持ち
　合わせている」
dialogues.en: "He's not a bad person. He still has a human heart."
dialogues.text: "He's not a bad person. He still has a human heart."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「怖いね」
dialogues.en: "He's scary though."
dialogues.text: "He's scary though."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっとな」
dialogues.en: "A little, yeah."
dialogues.text: "A little, yeah."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、指で隙間を作って、くくくと笑って見せ
た。
dialogues.en:
Making a line in the earth with my finger, I started
snickering to myself.
dialogues.text:
Making a line in the earth with my finger, I started
snickering to myself.

dialogues.jp:
月城にとって、杉並みたいな友達も、悪くない
のかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Maybe having a friend like Suginami would be good for
Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
Maybe having a friend like Suginami would be good for
Tsukishiro.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「嫌いじゃないけど、やっぱり苦手だよ」
dialogues.en:
"He's not dislikable... but we're just not used to him, I
gues."
dialogues.text:
"He's not dislikable... but we're just not used to him, I
gues."

dialogues.jp:
不思議とその言葉は、杉並本人にのみ向けられ
た言葉ではないように思えた。
dialogues.en:
Strange words, which probably should've been directed at
Suginami himself.
dialogues.text:
Strange words, which probably should've been directed at
Suginami himself.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、俺は今日はこれで帰るわ」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'd head back for today."
dialogues.text: "Well, I'd head back for today."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「もう、帰っちゃうんだ」
dialogues.en: "So soon?"
dialogues.text: "So soon?"

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp:
「杉並のヤツを捕まえにいかないと、いけない
　からな」
dialogues.en:
"If I don't go now, I won't be able to catch up to that
Suginami."
dialogues.text:
"If I don't go now, I won't be able to catch up to that
Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「そっか。じゃあ、お願いするよ」
dialogues.en: "I see. Please do your best."
dialogues.text: "I see. Please do your best."

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、悪いようにはしない」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, I won't let anything bad happen."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, I won't let anything bad happen."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、それを聞くと拾った手袋を手にはめ、
ぺこりと頭を下げた。
dialogues.en:
Upon hearing that, Tsukishiro put her gloves back on, and
bowed deeply to me.
dialogues.text:
Upon hearing that, Tsukishiro put her gloves back on, and
bowed deeply to me.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとう、ございます」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you, very much."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you, very much."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。じゃあな」
dialogues.en: "No problem. Later."
dialogues.text: "No problem. Later."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城に向けて手を振ると、杉並が消えて
いった茂みの方へ入った。
dialogues.en:
Waving goodbye to Tsukishiro, I started towards the
direction Suginami had disappeared into.
dialogues.text:
Waving goodbye to Tsukishiro, I started towards the
direction Suginami had disappeared into.

dialogues.jp:
茂みを抜け林を抜けると、案の定桜公園の方へ
出た。
dialogues.en: The route eventually led me to the Sakura Park.
dialogues.text: The route eventually led me to the Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp:
辺りを見回すと、探す手間もなく杉並を見つけ
ることができた。
dialogues.en: A quick look around, and in no time, I had spotted Suginami.
dialogues.text: A quick look around, and in no time, I had spotted Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
広場近くのベンチにどっかりと座り、のんきに
パックのジュースを飲んでいた。
dialogues.en:
He was sitting on a bench, calmly drinking out of a packet
juice bottle.
dialogues.text:
He was sitting on a bench, calmly drinking out of a packet
juice bottle.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、おもむろにその隣に座る。
dialogues.en: I quietly sat down next to him.
dialogues.text: I quietly sat down next to him.

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ……お前」
dialogues.en: "Hey... you."
dialogues.text: "Hey... you."

dialogues.jp:
と話を続けようとすると、俺の方を見てにやり
と笑う杉並。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to continue, but Suginami interrupted me first,
that stupid grin on his face.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to continue, but Suginami interrupted me first,
that stupid grin on his face.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "--Want a sip?"
dialogues.text: "--Want a sip?"

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、飲んでいたパックを差し出してく
る。緑の野菜ジュースだった。
dialogues.en:
He presented the juice packet to me. It was green in colour,
looking like vegetable juice.
dialogues.text:
He presented the juice packet to me. It was green in colour,
looking like vegetable juice.

dialogues.jp: 「野郎が飲んでたストローで飲めるかッ」
dialogues.en: "If you already have, only through a straw."
dialogues.text: "If you already have, only through a straw."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「間接キッスが気になる年頃か」
dialogues.en:
"You're in the age where you can notice indirect kisses,
eh."
dialogues.text:
"You're in the age where you can notice indirect kisses,
eh."

dialogues.jp:
杉並はくだらないことを言いながら、パックの
ジュースを飲む。四角いパックがメコメコとへ
こんでいく。
dialogues.en:
Going on with his mindless banter, he continued drinking his
juice. The square packet started to deflate.
dialogues.text:
Going on with his mindless banter, he continued drinking his
juice. The square packet started to deflate.

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、お前今日は何しに学校へ来てたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, why did you go to school today?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, why did you go to school today?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺か？　俺は、卒パの準備だ」
dialogues.en: "Me? For graduation party preparations."
dialogues.text: "Me? For graduation party preparations."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「卒パ？　お前がか？」
dialogues.en: "Graduation party? And you?"
dialogues.text: "Graduation party? And you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「もちろん、｛・／表｝の卒パではないがな」
dialogues.en:
"Of course. A graduation party without my input, would be
nothing."
dialogues.text:
"Of course. A graduation party without my input, would be
nothing."

dialogues.jp:
ズズズとパックが空になった音を立てると、そ
れをくしゃっと丸めて、放り投げる。
dialogues.en:
Finishing up the final drops of his juice, he threw the
packet away.
dialogues.text:
Finishing up the final drops of his juice, he threw the
packet away.

dialogues.jp:
それは外灯の柱に当たって、ゴミ箱にすとんと
落ちた。
dialogues.en: It bounced off a lamp post, and neatly into a waste basket.
dialogues.text: It bounced off a lamp post, and neatly into a waste basket.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「その途中で、学校に来るはずのない朝倉を見
　かけてな。悪いとは思ったが、｛つ／尾行｝けさせて
　もらった」
dialogues.en:
"On the way there, I saw you were heading to school as well.
I decided to tail you, figuring you were up to no good."
dialogues.text:
"On the way there, I saw you were heading to school as well.
I decided to tail you, figuring you were up to no good."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……お前が、悪いと思っている訳がない」
dialogues.en: "...That's rich coming from you."
dialogues.text: "...That's rich coming from you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、それもよかろう。──しかし、月城嬢
　は面白いじゃないか。いつの間にあんな後輩
　と知り合いになったんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"That may well be true. --In any case, Tsukishiro-jou
certainly is interesting. How long have you known her?"
dialogues.text:
"That may well be true. --In any case, Tsukishiro-jou
certainly is interesting. How long have you known her?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっとな」
dialogues.en: "Just for awhile."
dialogues.text: "Just for awhile."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ほう、もう少し詳しく聞きたいものだ」
dialogues.en: "Hou, this seems to require a deeper explanation."
dialogues.text: "Hou, this seems to require a deeper explanation."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前に教える必要はない」
dialogues.en: "You don't need to know any more."
dialogues.text: "You don't need to know any more."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ふん、それもよかろう。俺は、お前達のなれ
　そめに興味がある訳ではない。朝倉の恥ずか
　しい告白が聞けるかと思っただけだ」
dialogues.en:
"Hm, fine. I don't have that much interest in the two of you
anyway. I just wanted to know how you confessed, that's
all."
dialogues.text:
"Hm, fine. I don't have that much interest in the two of you
anyway. I just wanted to know how you confessed, that's
all."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「嫌なヤツだ」
dialogues.en: "...So irritating."
dialogues.text: "...So irritating."

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、それを聞いて、フッと笑う。幾度とな
く聞いたその台詞は、もはや挨拶に近い。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's reaction to my insult was a simple grin. The
amount of times I've said that to him, it might as well be a
greeting.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's reaction to my insult was a simple grin. The
amount of times I've said that to him, it might as well be a
greeting.

dialogues.jp: 「杉並……、おまえに頼みがある」
dialogues.en: "Suginami... I want you to do me a favour."
dialogues.text: "Suginami... I want you to do me a favour."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「俺に、頼み？　金以外の相談なら、聞こう」
dialogues.en: "A favour, me? As long as it's not about money, I'd listen."
dialogues.text: "A favour, me? As long as it's not about money, I'd listen."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……誰がお前に金など借りるか。もっと別の
　ことだ」
dialogues.en:
"...Who would want to borrow money from you? Of course it's
something else."
dialogues.text:
"...Who would want to borrow money from you? Of course it's
something else."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おっと、先に言っておくが、俺はいたってノー
　マルだぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"Whoops, anyone would assume that from you. It's normal for
you."
dialogues.text:
"Whoops, anyone would assume that from you. It's normal for
you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「俺だってノーマルだ。誰もそんな話をするつ
　もりはない」
dialogues.en:
"And I'm not normal in general? I never said one thing about
money."
dialogues.text:
"And I'm not normal in general? I never said one thing about
money."

dialogues.jp: 俺は、コホンと咳払いして、場を仕切り直す。
dialogues.en: Clearing my throat, I went back to the point."
dialogues.text: Clearing my throat, I went back to the point."

dialogues.jp:
「月城のことなんだけど、俺や月城が体育館裏
　にいたことや、月城が人形を使って喋ってい
　るってことは、黙っててもらえないか？」
dialogues.en:
"Now that you know about Tsukishiro, the back of the gym,
and the doll that talks... don't say anything about it to
anyone."
dialogues.text:
"Now that you know about Tsukishiro, the back of the gym,
and the doll that talks... don't say anything about it to
anyone."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「月城嬢のことをか？」
dialogues.en: "About Tsukishiro-jou?"
dialogues.text: "About Tsukishiro-jou?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、わかっているとは思うが、月城はあま
　り人と付き合うのが得意じゃない」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. I'm sure you've seen it for yourself, but meeting new
people isn't one of Tsukishiro's strong points."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. I'm sure you've seen it for yourself, but meeting new
people isn't one of Tsukishiro's strong points."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、あれなら友人などできまいな」
dialogues.en: "And so, she doesn't make any friends."
dialogues.text: "And so, she doesn't make any friends."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それに、あの場所は訳ありでな」
dialogues.en: "And, don't talk about the reason why we're there too."
dialogues.text: "And, don't talk about the reason why we're there too."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「――今の月城嬢の話を他人にしたところで、
　面白くもなければ、誰の興味もひかないだろ
　うな」
dialogues.en:
"--Right now, the average person wouldn't find talk of
Tsukishiro-jou interesting anyway."
dialogues.text:
"--Right now, the average person wouldn't find talk of
Tsukishiro-jou interesting anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「くだらん心配だ」
dialogues.en: "You're worrying for nothing."
dialogues.text: "You're worrying for nothing."

dialogues.jp: 杉並がそう言って笑う。
dialogues.en: Suginami smiled as he spoke.
dialogues.text: Suginami smiled as he spoke.

dialogues.jp:
彼がそう言うなら、そうなのだろう。俺は杉並
の嘲笑するような笑いを見ながら、少し安心し
た。
dialogues.en:
Is it really as he said? The lack of any sneering or scorn
in his smile made me feel relieved.
dialogues.text:
Is it really as he said? The lack of any sneering or scorn
in his smile made me feel relieved.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「……だが、俺個人としては、月城嬢に興味が
　ない訳ではない」
dialogues.en:
"...But, that doesn't mean that myself, as an individual,
has no interest in her."
dialogues.text:
"...But, that doesn't mean that myself, as an individual,
has no interest in her."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「人に話すも話さないもその後だな」
dialogues.en:
"Whether or not I talk to other people about it, takes a
backseat to that."
dialogues.text:
"Whether or not I talk to other people about it, takes a
backseat to that."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "--Why you-"
dialogues.text: "--Why you-"

dialogues.jp:
思わず、ベンチを立ち、下唇を噛みながら杉並
を見下ろす。
dialogues.en:
I unconsciously stood up from the bench, glaring downwards
at him.
dialogues.text:
I unconsciously stood up from the bench, glaring downwards
at him.

dialogues.jp: そんな俺をニヤニヤと笑いながら見上げる杉並。
dialogues.en: Conversely, he grinned widely as he looked up at me.
dialogues.text: Conversely, he grinned widely as he looked up at me.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「彼女のことになると、ムキになる朝倉を見る
　のも非常に興味を惹かれるんでな」
dialogues.en:
"As soon as she's in trouble, you quickly get passionate,
eh."
dialogues.text:
"As soon as she's in trouble, you quickly get passionate,
eh."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ちッ」
dialogues.en: "Pah."
dialogues.text: "Pah."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、二の句を告げずに、どっかりとベンチに
腰を下ろす。
dialogues.en: Hearing his second line, I fell back to my seat with a sigh.
dialogues.text: Hearing his second line, I fell back to my seat with a sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、あまり気にするな。ハゲるぞ」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry so much. You'd go bald."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry so much. You'd go bald."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前がハゲろ」
dialogues.en: "You'd go bald first."
dialogues.text: "You'd go bald first."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ハゲと言ったヤツがハゲだ」
dialogues.en: "It takes one to know one."
dialogues.text: "It takes one to know one."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ハゲと言ったヤツがハゲだと言ったヤツがハ
　ゲだ」
dialogues.en: "It takes one to know one to know one."
dialogues.text: "It takes one to know one to know one."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ハゲと言ったヤツがハゲだと言ったヤツがハ
　ゲだと言ったヤツがハゲだ」
dialogues.en: "It takes one to know one to know one to know one."
dialogues.text: "It takes one to know one to know one to know one."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……俺がハゲでいいよ。ったく、かったりぃ」
dialogues.en: "...Fine, I'd go bald, sheesh. How troublesome."
dialogues.text: "...Fine, I'd go bald, sheesh. How troublesome."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ふさふさの頭をかきあげ、ふぅと大きな
息を吐いた。
dialogues.en: Messing with my hair a bit, I sighed deeply.
dialogues.text: Messing with my hair a bit, I sighed deeply.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前は、明日も月城嬢のところへいくのか？」
dialogues.en: "Will you be with Tsukishiro-jou tomorrow as well?"
dialogues.text: "Will you be with Tsukishiro-jou tomorrow as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さあな」
dialogues.en: "Who knows."
dialogues.text: "Who knows."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「明後日は？」
dialogues.en: "And the day after?"
dialogues.text: "And the day after?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さあな！」
dialogues.en: "Who knows!"
dialogues.text: "Who knows!"

dialogues.speaker: Suignami
dialogues.jp: 「――なるほど、お前の予定はよくわかった」
dialogues.en: "--I see, your schedule is all laid out before me."
dialogues.text: "--I see, your schedule is all laid out before me."

dialogues.jp: 杉並は、腰をあげ、大きく伸びをした。
dialogues.en: Suginami stood up from the bench, stretching.
dialogues.text: Suginami stood up from the bench, stretching.

dialogues.jp:
そして、挨拶もせず、手も振らず、俺の方を見
て、ニヤリと笑うと追いかける間もなくどこか
へ行ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
And with a goodbye, a wave, and that usual annoying grin,
ran off somewhere.
dialogues.text:
And with a goodbye, a wave, and that usual annoying grin,
ran off somewhere.

dialogues.jp: ◆杉並乱入◆
dialogues.en: ◆Suginami The Intruder◆
dialogues.text: ◆Suginami The Intruder◆

dialogues.jp:
春休みを満喫していた俺だが、やはり月城のこ
とが気になって、様子を見に出かけた。
dialogues.en:
Having spent an entire day sleeping, I ended up being
worried about Tsukishiro, and went to see her.
dialogues.text:
Having spent an entire day sleeping, I ended up being
worried about Tsukishiro, and went to see her.

dialogues.jp:
月城に、この草のことをもう一度｛たず／訊｝ねたが、こ
の草については誰も教えてはいけないのだと言
われてしまう。
dialogues.en:
I once again asked her whether I could tell anyone of the
plant, and the answer remained the same.
dialogues.text:
I once again asked her whether I could tell anyone of the
plant, and the answer remained the same.

dialogues.jp:
人形を通じてだが、俺と月城は、しばらくの間、
話をしていた。しかし、そこを不意に現われた
杉並に目撃されてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro and I continued talking, through the doll. But
Suginami made a sudden appearance.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro and I continued talking, through the doll. But
Suginami made a sudden appearance.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、いつもの調子で、月城をからかうと、
そのまま公園の方へ行ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Suginami, being Suginami, bantered a bit with Tsukishiro,
before heading off for the park.
dialogues.text:
Suginami, being Suginami, bantered a bit with Tsukishiro,
before heading off for the park.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城のことを黙ってもらうため、杉並を
探し出し、彼女のことを人には言うなと強く言
いつける。
dialogues.en:
I looked for him afterwards, requesting him not to tell
anyone about Tsukishiro and her matters.
dialogues.text:
I looked for him afterwards, requesting him not to tell
anyone about Tsukishiro and her matters.

dialogues.jp:
杉並は、月城のことを誰かにいうことに興味は
ないと笑って言うが、
dialogues.en:
Suginami responded with a smile that nobody is really
interested in Tsukishiro's matters anyway,
dialogues.text:
Suginami responded with a smile that nobody is really
interested in Tsukishiro's matters anyway,

dialogues.jp:
月城本人や、月城のことに躍起になっている俺
には、大いに興味があると笑うのだった。
dialogues.en:
But that he does have a big interest in why I'm so desperate
for him to shut up about it.
dialogues.text:
But that he does have a big interest in why I'm so desperate
for him to shut up about it.

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず、何を考えているのかわからないヤ
ツだが……当面のところ、おもしろ半分に月城
の聖域が公表されることはなさそうだ。
dialogues.en:
As usual, I can't tell what he's thinking... but it appears
that he won't blab to everyone about Tsukishiro, anyway.
dialogues.text:
As usual, I can't tell what he's thinking... but it appears
that he won't blab to everyone about Tsukishiro, anyway.
